sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(frame):
    seg=frame.segmentation; out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbNM' and n['pixels']>=16 and n['boundary'][0][0]<55:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    leg=[(n['color'],n['pixels']) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['boundary'][0][0]>=55]
    return sorted(out), leg
action(['UP'])
print('UP:', *snap(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print('RIGHT:', *snap(current_frame))
action(['DOWN'])
print('DOWN:', *snap(current_frame), 'lvl?', last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(frame):
    seg=frame.segmentation; out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbNM' and n['pixels']>=16 and n['boundary'][0][0]<55:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    leg=[(n['color'],n['pixels']) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['boundary'][0][0]>=55]
    return sorted(out), leg
action(['UP'])
print('UP:', *snap(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print('RIGHT:', *snap(current_frame))
action(['DOWN'])
print('DOWN:', *snap(current_frame), 'lvl?', last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
